_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. an environment sheet of a small roadside motel: a low L of rooms off a coastal highway with a pole sign reading DRIFTWOOD MOTEL VACANCY in pale neon; the lobby with a night-audit desk, a CRT, a desk bell, a key rack, a vending machine, a glass door, a dim hallway with an ice machine; labeled THE DRIFTWOOD MOTEL. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
